UK licensed product information for the immediate-release preparation advises caution in those with mild to moderate renal impairment, while allowing for an oral dose of trospium chloride 20 mg once daily, or every alternate day, in those with severe re- nal impairment, defined as creatinine clearance (CC) of between 10 and 30 mL/minute per 1.73m2. US licensed product information for the immediate-release prep- aration recommends a dose of 20 mg daily at bedtime for those with severe renal impairment (defined as CC less than 30 mL/minute). The modified-release preparation is not recom- mended for use in patients with severe renal impairment.
